name: Turnout of registered voters, most recent general election
source: California Secretary of State, November 5, 2024 General Election Voter Participation Statistics by County
notes: The State report records 148,916 total voters and 214,883 registered voters for Monterey County, with turnout of registered voters reported as 69.30%. This is the most recent general election series found and matches the indicator denominator. This is a Monterey County proxy permitted by portrait scale policy; it is not Carmel city turnout. Tier 1 City election sources were checked but no citywide registered-voter turnout denominator was available; the 2,136 mayor-contest votes are not unique voter participation. Tier 2 California Secretary of State county participation exhibit provides a matching registered-voter denominator. The captured exhibit files are copied into the Carmel evidence tenant.
